query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_lancamentos,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + 
      CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) +
      CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total_faturamento
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 5 AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2026
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY total_faturamento DESC;
